label: Danish Jersey

about.text: A Danish dairy breed descended from Jersey cattle brought from the Channel Island of Jersey. About 5,200 head were imported to Denmark between about 1896 and 1909, and early breeding centred on Fünen. The breed makes about 13 percent of the Danish dairy herd, and its milk averaged 7,626 kg per lactation in 2023, with 6.00 percent fat.

Wikipedia, read with WebFetch: 'the average milk yield per lactation recorded in 2023 ... was 7626 kg'. The article's wording on the cow count is ambiguous, so no herd size is taken from it.
